why_ai: Unlicensed screen software whose dashboards and queries AI-native analytics tools increasingly generate directly.
why_clarity: Correct numbers are checkable, but metric definitions are contested and each estate is configured differently.
why_digital: Data in, software built and sold remotely, delivered as online dashboards.

why_ai: Most ad hoc requests repeat answered questions, which an AI assistant over the warehouse answers directly.
why_clarity: Each request has a checkable answer and many recur, though questions vary in phrasing.
why_digital: Questions arrive in chat and answers are queries and numbers returned on screen.

why_ai: Usage, lineage and duplication are computable, so retirement decisions automate with no accountable human required.
why_clarity: Usage and duplication metrics define the task; whether a deletion was safe surfaces only later.
why_digital: Works entirely on platform metadata and logs, delivered as governance software.

why_ai: Pipeline failures repeat with remedies already recorded in chat, ideal for AI diagnosis and remediation agents.
why_clarity: A pipeline either refreshes correctly or not, and failure types recur often.
why_digital: Alerts, logs and code in, fixes deployed to pipelines on screen.

why_ai: Engineering software where AI makes the buyer's build-it-yourself alternative steadily cheaper.
why_clarity: Latency and tenant isolation are measurable targets, though each host product integrates differently.
why_digital: Software components embedded in other software products, sold to engineering teams remotely.

why_ai: Software work, but fitting decisions to shop-floor contexts needs operational understanding AI tools lack.
why_clarity: Decisions are recurring and bounded, but whether the prompt changed the shift outcome is slower to see.
why_digital: Operational data in and software out, though delivered to devices on physical floors and sold to operations.

why_ai: Definitions already exist as stored query logic that AI can compare and reconcile automatically.
why_clarity: Two metrics either compute the same number or not, though choosing the right definition is organisational.
why_digital: Query logic and semantic models in, governed definitions delivered in software.

why_ai: General-purpose LLMs over warehouses substitute directly for a dedicated natural language query product.
why_clarity: Answers are checkable against the governed model, but confident wrong answers often go unnoticed.
why_digital: Text questions in, generated queries and numbers out, all on screen.

why_ai: Mining complete, structured query logs is exactly what AI analysis does without a human provider.
why_clarity: No agreed deliverable exists; what counts as insight from how an organisation asks is undefined.
why_digital: Built entirely from stored query logs and delivered as a software insight layer.

why_ai: AI-native assistants threaten to answer business users directly, bypassing the dashboard platform itself.
why_clarity: Success means correct answers without an analyst, but correctness depends on contested definitions.
why_digital: Fully software product bought by departments and used on screen.

why_ai: Exports, transformations and recombinations are observable steps that AI can replicate and automate.
why_clarity: Refreshable governed spreadsheets either reconcile to the warehouse or they do not.
why_digital: Warehouse data and spreadsheets in, governed spreadsheet surfaces delivered on screen.
